meta.name: hyperframes-keyframes
meta.description: Use when a HyperFrames composition needs a punch-in, punch-out, zoom, reframe, Ken Burns treatment, camera move, visual match/whip handoff, or other seek-safe 2D/3D keyframes; also for GSAP, CSS keyframes, Anime.js, WAAPI, FLIP, paths, masks, SVG morph/draw, text trails, 3D depth, or `hyperframes keyframes` diagnostics. Don't use for broad scene strategy, brand design, media sourcing, captions, or general video planning.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 给视频镜头加上推拉缩放与镜头运动动画
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果想让视频片段有缩放、推拉或镜头运动等动画效果。
copy.tagline_en: Add punch-in, zoom, and camera-move keyframes to video shots
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you're animating zooms, punch-ins, or camera moves inside video shots.

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 会给 HyperFrames 合成的可见元素写 seek-safe 关键帧动画,如推近、缩放、运镜、遮罩转场,并用 hyperframes lint、check、keyframes 等命令和快照做像素验证。
howto.when: 当 HyperFrames 合成需要推近、缩放、运镜、匹配或甩镜转场等 2D/3D 关键帧时触发;不用于整体场景策略、品牌设计、素材选取、字幕或视频规划。

say.text: 给这个镜头加一段推近,先慢后快
给主体做一次缓慢平移缩放的 Ken Burns 效果
say.note: 在一个 wrapper 上同时做位移与缩放关键帧

say.text: 用 mask 做一个方向性擦除转场

howto.what_en: Once installed, Claude writes seek-safe keyframes for the visible elements of a HyperFrames composition — punch-ins, zooms, camera moves, mask handoffs — then verifies pixels with hyperframes lint, check, keyframes and snapshots.
howto.when_en: Triggers when a HyperFrames composition needs 2D/3D keyframes such as punch-in, zoom, reframe, camera move, or match/whip handoff. Not for scene strategy, brand design, media sourcing, captions, or video planning.

say_en.text: Add a punch-in on this shot, slow then fast
say_en.note: Writes scale plus x/y keyframes and verifies with keyframes

say_en.text: Give the subject a slow Ken Burns pan and zoom
say_en.note: One wrapper animated for both translation and scale

say_en.text: Make a directional wipe transition with a mask
say_en.note: Interpolates clip-path or mask on an inner wrapper
